senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פָּרַח) [to break through,] to grow, increase, be fruitful.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 57a:6">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>כלומר פְּרוּ ורבו וכ׳</he> intimating, ‘multiply and increase like chickens’.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:2">Num. R. s. 11</cite> <he>את פְּרֵה ורבה לגוי גדול</he> be thou fruitful and grow to be a great nation.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מה … היה פָּרֶה ורבה</he> whatever existed in the Temple grew and increased (v. <cite ref="Q01681"><he>פַּרְוַיִם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chagigah 16a:7">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>פָּרִין ורבין כבני אדם</he> they increase by propagation like human beings.

<cite ref="Chullin 92a:11-19">Ḥull. 92ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>כפרחת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 40:10">Gen. XL, 10</cite>) <he>הגיע לִפְרוֹת ולרבות …</he> the time has come for Israel to grow and increase (as a nation); a. fr.

<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:15">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>דגים קטנים מַפְרִין ומרבין ומברין כל גופו וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מפרין ומרבין גופו וכ׳</he>) small fish make fruitful (increase the sexual vigor) and strengthen the whole body of man; <cite ref="Berakhot 57b:15">ib. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>מפרין ומברין</he> (Ms. M. <he>מפרין ומרבין</he>); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a:7">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>מפרין ומרבין</he> (read: <he>ומַבְרִין</he>); a. e.—[

senses.gloss: to increase the rent above the original stipulation in consideration of a loan, v. פָּרַז.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:5">B. Mets. V, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:8">69ᵇ</cite>) <he>מפרין על שדהו ואין חוששין וכ׳</he> Ar. (Y. ed. <he>ואין חושש</he>—which indicates that <he>מפרין</he> is singular, fr. <cite ref="Q01879"><he>פָּרַן</he></cite> q. v.).]
